title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.23443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient expert routing is a fundamental challenge in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) systems, particularly for heterogeneous collections of independently trained Large Language Mod els (LLMs). Existing routing approaches typically rely on jointly trained gating networks, prompt-based predictors, or computationally expensive multi-model inference, limiting their flexibility and efficiency. This paper presents ScoutRoute, a lightweight post-hoc routing framework that predicts expert competence using internal language model signals extracted from a single forward pass through an inexpensive scout model. Hidden-state representations are used to estimate cross-model competence through lightweight logistic probes, while logit-derived confidence measures are incorporated within a domain-aware routing strategy for efficient expert selec tion without modifying the underlying language models. translated_title: ScoutRoute：基于内部语言模型信号的高效混合专家路由
translated_abstract: 高效的专家路由是混合专家系统中的一个根本性挑战，尤其是对于独立训练的大型语言模型的异构集合。现有的路由方法通常依赖于联合训练的门控网络、基于提示的预测器或计算成本高昂的多模型推理，这限制了它们的灵活性和效率。本文提出了 ScoutRoute，一个轻量级的后验路由框架，它利用从一个廉价的侦察模型单次前向传播中提取的内部语言模型信号来预测专家能力。隐状态表示被用于通过轻量级逻辑回归探针来估计跨模型能力，同时将对数置信度度量纳入域感知路由策略中，从而在不修改底层语言模型的情况下实现高效的专家选择。ScoutRoute 在五个开放权重语言模型上进行了评估…
tldr: ScoutRoute 是一个轻量级后验路由框架，通过廉价的侦察模型单次前向传播提取隐状态与 logit 置信度等内部信号，结合域感知策略为混合专家系统高效选择专家，无需修改或联合训练底层语言模型。
en_tdlr: ScoutRoute is a lightweight post-hoc routing framework that predicts expert competence using internal signals (hidden states and logit-derived confidence) from a single forward pass through an inexpensive scout model, combined with a domain-aware strategy to efficiently select experts in MoE systems without modifying the underlying language models.
